captured_utc_basis: the retrieval date recorded by the session that made the capture (data/injuries.json meta.retrieved_utc = 2026-11-14). The exact clock time was not recorded by that session, so midnight UTC is used as a conservative floor and is labelled as such. It is EARLIER than any 2026 Week 10 kickoff, so treating it as pre-kickoff is safe; it is also EARLIER than the true read time, so it is conservative for the purpose of deciding which games it could have informed.
derivation: engine/linelab/availability.py reads the CSV form; this file is a lossless reshape of the committed JSON to that form, not a re-fetch

note: This capture was NOT re-fetched by the session that published the 2026-11-16 capture. It is the previously committed transcription, reshaped so that a mechanical delta between two official reads can be computed instead of an eyeball comparison.
